entries.summary: Vagrant Story follows Ashley Riot into Leá Monde, a ruined city caught in a struggle over religious and political power.
body: Vagrant Story follows Ashley Riot into Leá Monde, a ruined city caught in a struggle over religious and political power. Square released the PlayStation game in 2000. Its enclosed streets, cellars and stone chambers place a solitary investigator inside a city that rarely offers a straightforward route or explanation.

Combat pauses while Ashley selects an enemy body part within his weapon's reach. Timed follow-up attacks extend a chain, but raise Risk. Continuing an attack can therefore make the next exchange less safe. The system asks for both a tactical choice before the blow and a rhythmic response after it.

Weapons develop different strengths against different enemy classes, and workshops allow equipment to be combined and adjusted. A disappointing hit can be a reason to reconsider the weapon rather than simply repeat the attack. Preparation makes the city's next locked room or unfamiliar creature a practical problem as well as a mystery.

entries.summary: Final Fantasy VIII begins with young people training for a profession that sends them into a war.
body: Final Fantasy VIII begins with young people training for a profession that sends them into a war. Squall belongs to Balamb Garden, a school for mercenaries, and becomes a member of SeeD. Released for PlayStation in Japan in 1999, the game moves between school life, military assignments and his growing relationship with Rinoa.

Guardian Forces do more than appear as summoned creatures. Junctioning them opens abilities and lets stored magic improve a character's statistics. Draw supplies spells from enemies and other sources. Because a spell can be both something to cast and something to keep equipped, the inventory becomes part of character building.

Triple Triad places a compact card game inside this much larger journey. Its cards can be collected and played against people encountered along the way. Alongside the main battles and scenes, it gives towns and schools another reason to be revisited: someone there may have a hand worth challenging.

entries.summary: Warhorse Studios' Kingdom Come: Deliverance places Henry, the son of a blacksmith, in medieval Bohemia.
body: Warhorse Studios' Kingdom Come: Deliverance places Henry, the son of a blacksmith, in medieval Bohemia. His village is attacked and his ordinary life is broken apart by a wider political conflict. Released in 2018, the role-playing game approaches this setting through settlements, work and social encounters rather than a magical chosen-one premise.

A sword is not an automatic solution. Position, weapon choice and learned combat techniques matter, while quests can also be approached through persuasion, stealth or other decisions. Henry's developing abilities make early vulnerability part of the experience: the player and the character have things to learn.

The surrounding population reacts to what Henry does. Theft, violence and persuasion are ways of moving through a quest, but they also affect the people he must return to. The historical setting supplies more than scenery; it gives those encounters different expectations, restrictions and consequences.

entries.summary: Star Fox: Assault returns Fox McCloud to combat on GameCube, with Namco developing and Nintendo publishing.
body: Star Fox: Assault returns Fox McCloud to combat on GameCube, with Namco developing and Nintendo publishing. Its 2005 adventure moves between aerial battles, ground vehicles and action on foot. The familiar Arwing is one part of the battlefield rather than Fox's only place within it.

An Arwing offers speed and flight; a Landmaster tank brings heavy ground fire; Fox can also run and use handheld weapons. Those changes alter the scale of a location. Something crossed quickly from the air can become cover, a target or a route when approached on the ground.

The local multiplayer mode supports four people in split screen. Vehicles and on-foot combat become tools in a shared space, with each player watching a different view of the action. It preserves a familiar living-room arrangement: one console, several controllers and everyone close enough to see a rival's reaction.
story_headings: Four views of the same fight

entries.summary: Three-character teams turn Marvel and Capcom fighters into combinations of active attacks, assists and timed resources.
body: Marvel vs. Capcom 3: Fate of Two Worlds brought its crossover to PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2011. A team contains three fighters drawn from Marvel comics and Capcom games. The selection makes unlikely combinations possible before a round begins: recognisable characters become parts of a team the player has assembled.

Calling an assist brings a teammate briefly into the fight. That extra attack can cover an approach or extend a combination, while changing the active fighter changes the available moves. Learning a team involves the relationships between its members, not only the commands of a favourite character.

X-Factor offers a limited burst of enhanced ability, giving a struggling team a way to turn the match. It adds a decision about when to spend a powerful resource. The spectacle of beams and airborne combinations rests on these choices about order, support and timing.

entries.summary: Street Fighter V arrived in 2016 with a new way to distinguish its fighters.
body: Street Fighter V arrived in 2016 with a new way to distinguish its fighters. The V-System gave each character an individual skill and a trigger ability. Familiar attacks still depended on distance and timing, but a shared pair of button commands could produce very different decisions from one fighter to the next.

A V-Skill could help with movement, defence or offence without spending the V-Gauge. Ryu's skill, for example, allowed a timed parry. The point was not to give everyone the same defensive technique: the differences made learning the opponent's character important alongside learning one's own.

V-Trigger spends a filled V-Gauge on a character-specific effect, while V-Reversal offers a way to interrupt pressure during a block. A separate EX Gauge powers enhanced special moves and Critical Arts. The match becomes a sequence of small exchanges that also changes which larger responses remain available.

entries.summary: Devil May Cry 3 looks back to an earlier Dante and his conflict with his twin brother Vergil.
body: Devil May Cry 3 looks back to an earlier Dante and his conflict with his twin brother Vergil. Its 2005 PlayStation 2 release makes that rivalry the centre of an action game built around a growing collection of melee weapons, firearms and fighting styles.

The original game asks the player to choose a style before a mission or at a Divinity Statue. Trickster, Swordmaster, Gunslinger and Royal Guard offer different priorities, with further styles unlocked later. That choice shapes the tools available during a difficult encounter rather than merely changing Dante's appearance.

Capcom's 2020 Switch edition added Free Style mode, allowing styles to be changed during combat. Keeping the versions distinct matters when watching a demonstration: a combination made possible by later switching was not necessarily available through the original 2005 controls. Reissues can revise how an older game is played as well as where it runs.

entries.summary: Horizon Forbidden West continued Aloy's journey in 2022 on both PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5.
body: Horizon Forbidden West continued Aloy's journey in 2022 on both PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. Guerrilla expanded the ways she could cross the world: swimming, more climbing possibilities and new traversal tools let the landscape offer routes above and below the familiar paths.

The Pullcaster helps Aloy reach or move objects, while the Shieldwing turns a drop into a glide. These tools change what a cliff, opening or ruined structure can offer. The map becomes easier to read when the player begins looking for places where an acquired tool creates a different approach.

Guerrilla also documented options for subtitles, controls, difficulty and the amount of guidance shown onscreen. These choices affect how the same encounters can be read and played. Accessibility sits alongside the new machines and environments as part of the practical work of making a large adventure usable.
story_headings: Let more people take the journey

entries.summary: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance takes Raiden into a direct action game developed by PlatinumGames with Kojima Productions.
body: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance takes Raiden into a direct action game developed by PlatinumGames with Kojima Productions. Released in 2013, it follows the cyborg swordsman in a world where private military companies employ advanced combat technology. The familiar Metal Gear setting now supports a different kind of confrontation.

Blade Mode lets the player aim the direction of Raiden's sword rather than simply watch a fixed finishing animation. A carefully placed strike can expose an enemy's energy source for Zandatsu. Cutting becomes both a visible effect and a way to recover the resources needed to keep fighting.

PlatinumGames records that the project began as Metal Gear Solid: Rising, intended to bridge earlier appearances of Raiden. When the collaboration changed, the setting moved to several years after Metal Gear Solid 4. The finished game therefore reflects a production change in its story as well as in its combat.

entries.summary: The Order: 1886 places Galahad and an order of knights in a reimagined Victorian London.
body: The Order: 1886 places Galahad and an order of knights in a reimagined Victorian London. Ready at Dawn's 2015 PlayStation 4 game combines an old-fashioned city and uniforms with invented weapons and a conflict involving human and supernatural enemies.

The studio's material research paid close attention to the differences between surfaces such as cloth, leather and metal. These were not simply colours applied to a model: the lighting had to make each material respond convincingly. Close views of coats and weapons make that work unusually visible.

Ready at Dawn also described reproducing characteristics of motion-picture lenses. Focus, framing and optical imperfections contribute to an image intended to resemble something photographed. The result offers a useful distinction when studying game graphics: a technically clean image and a deliberately photographic image are different artistic goals.

entries.summary: The Legend of Zelda first appeared in Japan in 1986 for the Famicom Disk System.
body: The Legend of Zelda first appeared in Japan in 1986 for the Famicom Disk System. Link's journey joins an overworld of woods, mountains and caves to a series of dungeons. The opening offers a place to enter and directions to try rather than a single track to the finish.

A new item can change the meaning of an earlier obstacle. Bombs, a raft or another acquired tool give the player reasons to revisit locations and test a suspicion. Progress depends partly on keeping a mental map: where something was seen can matter as much as which enemy was defeated.

The original disk release could record progress, and the later NES cartridge used battery-backed memory. Saving suited a world intended to be explored over more than one sitting. These are different physical versions of the same idea: the adventure could still be there when the player returned.
story_headings: Remember a place, return with a tool

entries.summary: Ed Boon began his professional game work programming pinball machines at Williams.
body: Ed Boon began his professional game work programming pinball machines at Williams. He tuned lights and sounds and contributed character voices, including Rudy in FunHouse. This background involved more than writing rules: a machine had to respond clearly enough, and loudly enough, to hold someone's attention in an arcade.

Boon and John Tobias helped create Mortal Kombat for Midway in 1992. Digitised performances of martial artists became its fighters. Boon handled programming and gameplay while Tobias brought artwork and character ideas; their close collaboration made it possible to try an idea and see it moving quickly.

Boon also supplied Scorpion's voice, connecting a programming role with one of the game's best-known performances. His later work carried Mortal Kombat into larger productions and helped establish Injustice. The career shows how a recognisable character can pass through changes in technology, team size and studio ownership.

entries.summary: NieR:Automata follows android soldiers including 2B, 9S and A2 in a conflict with machine lifeforms.
body: NieR:Automata follows android soldiers including 2B, 9S and A2 in a conflict with machine lifeforms. Released in 2017, it combines Yoko Taro's story with action developed by PlatinumGames. Ruined human spaces and the behaviour of their new inhabitants make the world worth examining between battles.

A sword handles nearby enemies while a Pod provides ranged support. Light and heavy attacks, evasive movement and different weapons give the player ways to change pace. Character levels and equipment upgrades sit alongside those action controls, joining a role-playing structure to a game that still requires direct responses.

PlatinumGames' character account identifies Pascal as a machine who rejects conflict and studies humanity. That detail complicates the simple division between allied android and hostile machine. The game asks the player to consider what an inhabitant does and believes, rather than trust the category assigned to its body.

entries.summary: Sid Meier's early work ranged from vehicle simulations to games about trade, travel and political power.
body: Sid Meier's early work ranged from vehicle simulations to games about trade, travel and political power. He co-founded MicroProse in 1982. F-15 Strike Eagle and Silent Service asked players to operate military machines; Pirates! combined navigation, combat and the changing fortunes of a character.

Railroad Tycoon and Civilization widened the scale of those decisions. Where to build or what to research affects options that appear later, so a small action can become part of a longer plan. The attraction is partly the chance to revise that plan when the map, rivals or available resources change.

Meier went on to co-found Firaxis in 1996 and entered the Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences Hall of Fame in 1999. His name became an unusually visible part of a game's identity. The studios and collaborators behind those games remain part of the history too; a signature is not the same thing as working alone.
story_headings: A name, and a shared body of work

entries.summary: Eidos-Montréal's Thief returned Garrett to a new version of the City in 2014.
body: Eidos-Montréal's Thief returned Garrett to a new version of the City in 2014. The master thief moves through a place marked by wealth, poverty and political unrest. The first-person view makes a doorway or a passing guard an immediate question about what can be reached without being noticed.

The studio described routes through the game without killing anyone, and even without causing an enemy alert. Such goals change the value of waiting, observing and finding another way around. A successful escape can be more important than defeating the person blocking the obvious path.

The available options include removing the onscreen interface and enabling an Iron Man mode that ends a run when Garrett dies. These settings alter how much information and safety the player receives. They make the same City support different tolerances for uncertainty and failure.
story_headings: An encounter need not become a fight

entries.summary: Nintendo 3DS launched in Japan in February 2011.
body: Nintendo 3DS launched in Japan in February 2011. Its upper screen could display stereoscopic images without special glasses, and a physical slider let the player adjust the effect or turn it off. Below it, the touch screen continued an interaction familiar from the Nintendo DS.

The Circle Pad, motion sensor and gyro sensor expanded the available inputs. The system also supported existing Nintendo DS software. That compatibility connected the new device to an established collection, while developers could decide how the newer controls and display suited their own games.

StreetPass exchanged data with nearby 3DS systems in sleep mode; SpotPass could receive material through supported wireless connections. Nintendo also included cameras for stereoscopic photographs and cards for augmented-reality play. The hardware proposed activities between game sessions, not only more elaborate pictures during them.

entries.summary: Pokémon Red and Green began the series on Game Boy in Japan in 1996.
body: Pokémon Red and Green began the series on Game Boy in Japan in 1996. A player travels through a world of towns, routes and battles while catching and raising Pokémon. Choosing a version begins the journey, but it also leaves reasons to talk to someone who owns the other one.

Trading lets two players exchange Pokémon through a Game Link cable. Battles let them bring their trained teams into direct competition. The handheld's portability matters here: a collection can travel with its owner, then become something to compare and exchange face to face.

Differences between the versions and Pokémon that evolve through trading make exchange part of completing a collection. The connection is therefore more than an optional scoreboard. A design built around collecting creates a practical use for another player's cartridge, time and willingness to trade.

entries.summary: Horizon Zero Dawn introduced Aloy, an outcast trying to understand her own past in a world inhabited by animal-like machines.
body: Horizon Zero Dawn introduced Aloy, an outcast trying to understand her own past in a world inhabited by animal-like machines. Guerrilla's 2017 action role-playing game set tribal settlements beside the remains of a much older technological civilisation. The two histories are connected, although their relationship is initially unclear.

Aloy's Focus helps her examine machines, and her weapons let her approach encounters with different preparations. Learning what a machine carries and how it moves can matter more than repeatedly striking its largest surface. Hunting becomes a sequence of observation, a chosen tool and a response to what changes.

The Focus can also recover recordings from ancient ruins. These fragments connect a place the player explores with people who once used it. The same device that helps Aloy read an immediate threat therefore helps her investigate the larger question of what happened to the world.

entries.summary: Aperture Desk Job puts a new employee behind a desk in the world of Portal.
body: Aperture Desk Job puts a new employee behind a desk in the world of Portal. Valve released the free playable short in March 2022 for the arrival of Steam Deck. An apparently ordinary first shift becomes an opportunity for the company's machinery and promises to go wrong.

Valve describes the short as a way to introduce the handheld's controls and features. Tasks in the scene make the player use those controls within a comic situation, rather than study a separate diagram. A hardware demonstration becomes something with a workplace, a companion and a reason to press the next button.

Valve explicitly presents Desk Job as neither Portal 3 nor a full sequel. Its smaller scale is part of the idea: it can acquaint someone with a device in one sitting. The exhibit belongs to the history of how new hardware teaches its owners, as well as the continuing fiction of Aperture Science.

entries.summary: Team NINJA's Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty places a nameless militia soldier in a demonic version of Later Han China.
body: Team NINJA's Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty places a nameless militia soldier in a demonic version of Later Han China. Released in 2023, the game draws on the era associated with the Three Kingdoms while deliberately turning it into fantasy. Its historical names and setting should not be mistaken for a documentary account.

Spirit rises through successful attacks and deflections and falls through damage and other costly actions. Reaching the lower limit leaves a fighter temporarily vulnerable. Defence can therefore become a way to gain the resources for an attack, making a well-timed response change more than the amount of health lost.

Raising flags increases Fortitude, setting a floor beneath the Morale that can be lost on defeat. Battle Flags also provide recovery and a return point. Exploring a battlefield can make another attempt more manageable, so progress includes establishing a foothold as well as reaching the next opponent.

entries.summary: PlayStation 2 launched in Japan on 4 March 2000, followed by North America and Europe later that year.
body: PlayStation 2 launched in Japan on 4 March 2000, followed by North America and Europe later that year. Its DVD drive carried new games and could also play films. For a living room, the purchase could introduce a new game console and a DVD player at the same time.

Compatibility with original PlayStation discs let many existing games remain useful on the new console. The new machine did not require every player to begin with an empty shelf. This is a different kind of hardware feature from a faster processor: it changes what an owner can bring from the previous generation.

Sony's history places network play, the EyeToy camera and an expanding range of DVD-based games across the PlayStation 2 era. These developments arrived through different software and accessories over its lifetime. The launch machine and the experience of using it years later are related, but not identical, historical moments.

entries.summary: Resident Evil 5 pairs Chris Redfield with Sheva Alomar in a campaign about a new biological threat.
body: Resident Evil 5 pairs Chris Redfield with Sheva Alomar in a campaign about a new biological threat. Its original console release began in Japan in March 2009. The partnership makes another character a continuing presence in a series where being isolated had often been central to the tension.

The campaign supports cooperative play. Two people must keep track of the situation and the needs of a partner, so supplies and recovery become shared concerns. The extra person can provide support, but also creates another position and another immediate problem to watch.

Capcom described the game's contrast between light and darkness as part of its visual approach. Bright locations could expose threats rather than simply make a space feel safe. Alongside the shift toward cooperative action, the lighting offers a way to examine how a series can change its presentation of fear.

entries.summary: Mass Effect 3 begins with Earth under attack and Commander Shepard seeking a way to resist the Reapers.
body: Mass Effect 3 begins with Earth under attack and Commander Shepard seeking a way to resist the Reapers. BioWare's 2012 game closes the original trilogy by making the search for allies part of a military emergency. Familiar relationships are now tested by a threat that reaches beyond one world.

Importing a previous save can carry decisions and relationships into the new campaign. The person meeting Shepard may therefore have a history the player helped create in an earlier game. For the trilogy, continuity becomes something stored and interpreted by software as well as something remembered by the audience.

Combat pairs cover and gunfire with technical and biotic abilities. Teammates can combine powers, giving squad selection a tactical purpose alongside its role in the story. The original release also offered cooperative multiplayer; that mode belongs to the 2012 game's history and should not be assumed to appear in every later edition.

entries.summary: This calendar selection brings together four releases from different years.
body: This calendar selection brings together four releases from different years. Burnout Revenge's Xbox 360 version arrived in 2006, I Am Alive followed in 2012, and NieR:Automata and Ghost Recon Wildlands appeared in 2017. The shared March slot is an editorial comparison, not a claim that they belong to one production or one year.

Criterion's Burnout Revenge made dangerous driving and spectacular collisions central to its racing. The Xbox 360 edition added ways to track online rivalries and share recorded crashes. A race could leave behind a short piece of evidence to show someone else, as well as a finishing position.

Ubisoft's I Am Alive makes climbing consume stamina. Even hanging from a ledge spends the resource, so a route must be considered before the character is stranded halfway up. Supplies that restore strength may also be useful later. Movement becomes a survival decision rather than a pause between threats.

NieR:Automata connects close combat with ranged Pod support and a story about androids and machines. Ghost Recon Wildlands opens out into a large mission space and cooperative squad action. Placing them beside the other games reveals different uses of movement: a quick response in an encounter, and a plan for approaching a place with others.
story_headings: One date, different kinds of movement

entries.summary: Ralph Baer was born in Germany in 1922 and escaped with his family to the United States in 1938.
body: Ralph Baer was born in Germany in 1922 and escaped with his family to the United States in 1938. His later training and engineering work preceded the television-game experiments for which he became known. The birth date marks a life, not the beginning of a game-design project.

At Sanders Associates in the 1960s, Baer worked with colleagues including Bill Harrison and Bill Rusch on devices that could produce interactive games on a television. Successive test units led to the Brown Box prototype. The work involved making a household display respond to a person holding a controller.

Magnavox developed the licensed technology into the Odyssey, released in 1972. Baer later donated prototypes, notes and schematics to the Smithsonian. Those surviving materials allow the finished commercial machine to be compared with earlier experiments, and preserve the contributions of the people who helped turn an idea into hardware.

entries.summary: Super Mario RPG brought Nintendo's characters into a role-playing adventure developed with Square.
body: Super Mario RPG brought Nintendo's characters into a role-playing adventure developed with Square. Released for Super Famicom in Japan in 1996, it sends Mario beyond the familiar rescue pattern after a new enemy takes over Bowser's castle. Towns, conversations and a travelling party give the journey a different scale.

Battles use commands, but a button pressed at the right moment can strengthen an attack or improve defence. This keeps a small physical action inside the turn-based structure. Choosing a move and carrying it out are connected, leaving room for both planning and practice.

Mallow and Geno join familiar figures including Bowser and Peach. Having a former enemy and the usual rescue target take roles in the party changes how Mario's world is encountered. The expanded cast gives battles different abilities while giving the adventure people to talk to, disagree with and rely on.
story_headings: A turn still needs a touch

entries.summary: Call of Duty: Warzone launched in March 2020 as a free-to-play game from Infinity Ward and Raven Software.
body: Call of Duty: Warzone launched in March 2020 as a free-to-play game from Infinity Ward and Raven Software. At launch, up to 150 players entered Verdansk in teams of three. It supported crossplay, allowing the same match to bring together friends using PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC.

The Gulag gave an eliminated player a one-on-one fight for a chance to return. Teammates could also spend in-match cash at Buy Stations to recover a fallen squad member. These systems made a defeat something the squad could respond to, instead of always ending that person's participation immediately.

Cash paid for equipment and other advantages, while optional Contracts offered rewards for taking on another task. Plunder made collecting cash the central goal and allowed repeated respawns. The two launch modes used the same broad environment to produce different reasons to move, take a risk or help a teammate.
